title: cyperus steudneri
intro: Cyperus steudneri, commonly known as Steudner's flatsedge, is a species of sedge in the family Cyperaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to help manage fever, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The health benefits of Cyperus steudneri include its immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been identified as the key compounds contributing to the plant's medicinal properties.
